source_quality.notes: text layer covers all 32 pages; the metric and the swarm updates were checked on the raster

task_reconstruction: Model Haiti's water crisis three ways: a system of stocks ranked by leverage, a groundwater calculation feeding a particle swarm, and a social network comparing two ways to hand water out.

section_map.summary: summary of the three models and their verdicts
the two kinds of scarcity and the wicked-problem framing
the general metric and the discipline table
the history and the current state of the case
the system of stocks and its assumptions
the particle swarm and its result
the social network and its two scores
the comparison of the two distribution methods
the strengths and weaknesses of each model

contributions.summary: a ranking of six interventions by whether each amplifies or dampens
a swarm that returns rainwater collection at about ten million dollars a year
a network in which the current method delivers 0.81 liters of 30
a health-center route that beats the elite route on both scores

dependency_graph.relation: the score is what the ranked interventions are meant to be judged by
the water lost to the sea bounds what the swarm may draw
the cost curve is one term of what the swarm minimizes
the drinking water the system isolates is what the network delivers

assumptions.summary: plenty of cleanable water exists and the transport of it is very low
waste of drinking water cannot change and corruption losses are large
the soil is uniform and the land shape stands in for the hydraulic head
gangs demand more than the elite, who demand more than the common person
health centers and their distributors keep none of the water

data_and_preprocessing.summary: heights read off a map by a fixed table of colors
treatment cost taken from a published curve
population growth of seventeen percent taken from a published projection
link weights assigned by hand from the social structure

models.summary: a single score for money left, sustainability and adoption
six stocks of water integrated down to drinking water
a diffusion over a map counting water lost to the sea
a published curve for the daily cost of treatment
a particle swarm over rainwater, wells and desalination
a weighted social network with two scores

verification.summary: one hundred runs at three growth rates compared by ANOVA
two unpaired t-tests on the two scores
the number of links varied, moving one method and not the other

results_trace.summary: piping ranks first and changing the supply ranks last
rainwater collection costs about ten million dollars a year
the elite route leaves the common person 0.81 liters of 30
the health-center route wins on both scores

writing_logic.summary: the summary names the problem wicked before any model
every assumption is followed at once by its reason
the design choices are posed as questions
each weakness names the situation that causes it

language_observations.summary: lets the quoted authority define the term in three sentences
sets once against now to make the fall
concedes a false assumption and defends it with although
concedes the missing optimum with although, then states what is found

visualization_observations.summary: Figure 2 draws the stocks and flows of the system model
Figure 4 shows the network and its controls
Figure 7 compares the two methods on both scores
a table pairs each discipline with what it contributes

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: pairing every assumption with its reason reads as careful
admitting the search cannot promise the best answer reads as honest

weaknesses.summary: the position update is printed with the velocity term unsubscripted and a stray one
the weights in the general score are never defined or used
the ocean loss the algorithm computes is never reported
a figure caption still contains a placeholder

independent_extensions.summary: rank interventions by whether each one amplifies or dampens the target
route a new good through a delivery system that already reaches the hard places

unresolved_questions: the weights a and b in the general score are never given values
the ocean loss computed by the diffusion is never reported
the position update as printed does not match the code in the appendix
the degree values in the sensitivity figure are left as a placeholder
the ten million dollar cost is not broken into its three sources
